findings.problem: This line was copied from the beginner version. It tells men who already exercise every day 'You don't need to be fit to start. Your first walk is just 10 minutes. That's it.' That contradicts the opening line ('You already move every day') and reads as talking down to them. It breaks the 'Respectful' part of the voice (brand/voice.md, part 1: 'No hype, no pressure, no talking down').
findings.fix: Replace line 8 with: "You don't need to change your routine. Just add 10 minutes of strength and mobility to what you already do."
